title: Handling of network rejection not due to congestion control

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for modifying an existing PDU session, initiated by the UE sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: IE included in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message indicating the timer value for back-off behavior.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: IE indicating whether re-attempts are allowed in equivalent PLMNs or S1 mode.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: IE indicating the reason for rejection in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: Back-off timer
entities.description: Timer started by UE upon receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT to prevent further modification requests for specific combinations.

entities.name: 5GSM cause not congestion-related
entities.description: Condition where 5GSM cause value is different from specified congestion-related causes.

entities.name: Timer value neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates a non-zero, non-deactivated value.

entities.name: Timer value deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates the timer is deactivated.

entities.name: Timer value zero
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates zero.

entities.name: UE shall not send PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Behavior where UE is prohibited from sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST for specific combinations until conditions are met.

relations.description: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains the Back-off timer value IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains the 5GSM cause IE.
If 5GSM cause is not congestion-related and Back-off timer value IE is included, UE establishes behavior to not send modification requests.
If timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts the back-off timer.
If timer value indicates deactivated, UE establishes behavior to not send modification requests indefinitely.
If timer value indicates zero, UE may send another PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST.
Back-off timer value IE guards conditions for timer behavior (non-zero, deactivated, or zero).
5GSM cause IE guards the condition for non-congestion-related causes.
